provenance.method: Words that occur in one variety's versions of at least 2 parallel stories and in no other variety's or MSA versions (data/stories/parallel), then curated by hand to drop story-specific content words and ambiguous forms.
provenance.note: Small (16 synthetic stories). To be extended by frequency contrast on real dialect text such as IADD.
